reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness skill that automates running RPG Maker MV/MZ games on macOS, integrating existing MTool translation files, modifying local game files, and creating an app launcher.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于在 macOS 上自动运行 RPG Maker MV/MZ 游戏、整合现有 MTool 翻译文件并创建启动器的 DeepSeek Harness 技能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness skill that automates running RPG Maker MV/MZ games on macOS, integrates existing MTool translation files, and creates an application launcher.

capabilities: Detects RPG Maker MV/MZ game structures on macOS
Sets up a local runtime environment
Integrates existing MTool translation files into game files
Backs up and modifies local game files
Runs local scripts and launches the game
